reviewer: Agent-assisted source and taxonomy desk review; not expert, legal, or field certification
purpose: Project one CC0 CAS historical specimen-lot record as text-locality evidence for the Species page, retaining the source locality verbatim and withholding the unverified coordinate.

source.provider: California Academy of Sciences, CAS Ichthyology via GBIF
source.citation: Fong J (2026). CAS Ichthyology (ICH). Version 150.545. California Academy of Sciences. Occurrence dataset. http://ipt.calacademy.org:8080/resource?r=ich&v=150.545 https://doi.org/10.15468/efh2ib accessed via GBIF.org on 2026-10-24.
source.reviewScope: Only the selected occurrence row and factual fields listed in this review; no images or unrelated dataset records.

occurrenceQuery.interpretation: The class-level search is a bounded administrative screen and is not used as proof of exact site membership. This specimen is selected because its CAS locality text explicitly names Angat Dam and Angat River.

taxonomyReview.name: Arius dispar Herre, 1926
taxonomyReview.limits: Current nomenclature cross-check only; it does not independently re-identify this CAS specimen or establish its locality.

coordinateReview.decision: Withhold from app and map. The source locality is a combined dam/river string and GBIF marks the datum as assumed; the coordinate is not treated as a verified collection station.

decision.reason: The preserved-specimen row has a stable catalog identifier, exact collection date, named source locality, determiner, record-level and dataset CC0 declarations, and an independent valid-name check. Projection is limited to one historical text-locality assertion with quality flags and explicit non-claims.
caveats: The GBIF waterBody field is blank. Preserve the combined source locality verbatim; do not assign the specimen to a specific river reach or draw a reservoir/riverside point.
The source date is 1929-05-18. This is historical evidence, not current presence or a complete Angat fish checklist.
GBIF reports individualCount 2 and infers occurrenceStatus PRESENT from the count; this remains one database occurrence record, not an abundance estimate.
The coordinate has 301 m uncertainty and a GBIF assumed-WGS84 flag; it is withheld from the app and map.
No catchability, legality, food safety, diet, bait, abundance, or fishing-access claim is made.

nonClaims: The record does not establish current presence, population size, abundance, a complete Angat or Bulacan fish list, or a precise point/reach within the combined locality.
The record does not establish fishing permission, legal catchability, food safety, diet, bait effectiveness, or public access.
No exact coordinates, map point, boundary, or waterbody geometry are part of the app projection.
